note: Real. Bucky Irving (TB RB) hurt his left foot in the Week 4 loss to Philadelphia (Sep 28, 2025) and played through it; Monday he had an MRI, Wednesday he was in a boot on crutches, and on Oct 5 Schefter reported a shoulder subluxation too. He was never put on IR, missed Weeks 5-12 (bye Week 9; seven games) and came back in Week 13 (Nov 30 vs ARI, 17 carries) per his ESPN 2025 game log: group B, backWeek 13. Your guess of IR was wrong; I found no IR move. The first ask (Sep 30) sees only Monday's news that he was getting an MRI, so it is a thin, early read; the second ask (Nov 11) comes after six missed games with Bowles saying the shoulder is what keeps him out and it's too soon to know about Week 11. Times: Heavy's datePublished (21:42Z Sep 29) for the Bowles MRI news (via Scott Reynolds of Pewter Report and Rick Stroud), ESPN's datePublished (16:17Z Oct 5) for Schefter's report, and CBS page timestamps for the RotoWire blurbs. I did not open Schefter's or Garafolo's own posts.
injury: left foot/ankle injury, Week 4 (Sep 28); MRI on Monday

news.source: Heavy (Todd Bowles, via Scott Reynolds, Pewter Report, and Rick Stroud, Tampa Bay Times)
news.words: Bowles says "quite a few" players are getting MRIs. Asked if Irving is one of the players getting an MRI, he confirmed that he's one of them. Irving's Week 5 status is unclear.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Mike Garafolo, NFL Network)
news.words: The Buccaneers are still gathering medical opinions on an apparent ankle and/or foot injury to Irving. He underwent an MRI on Monday, is still sore, and his status is up in the air for Sunday.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Greg Auman, FOX Sports)
news.words: Irving (ankle) was spotted wearing a boot on his left foot and using crutches at Wednesday's walkthrough practice.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Adam Schefter, ESPN)
news.words: Irving is dealing with a foot sprain that is not considered a long-term injury. He is viewed as week-to-week.
Irving not only has a foot sprain, but he is also dealing with a shoulder subluxation that is expected to sideline him for at least two weeks, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (Todd Bowles, via Greg Auman, FOX Sports)
news.words: Bowles said Wednesday that Irving (foot) will not suit up for Sunday's game. He won't practice Wednesday. His next opportunity will come in Week 10, after the bye.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Rick Stroud, Tampa Bay Times)
news.words: Irving (foot/shoulder) is not expected to participate in Wednesday's practice. He evidently remains in the rehab phase of his recovery, despite the fact that the Buccaneers are coming off a bye.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (Todd Bowles, via Scott Smith, Buccaneers.com)
news.words: Bowles said Monday that Irving's shoulder injury is what's keeping him sidelined, and he has to be able to take a hit before being cleared. Bowles added that it's too soon to know if Irving can play Week 11.
